additional_reviewed_sources.change: Only final failed-run FOS publication and summary formatting; constitutive and solver algorithms unchanged from INCO_14.
Preserve the nonfatal deferred Fs=1 gravity failure until SRM classifies it, enabling the intended Fs<1 search. Numerical acceptance criteria and material laws unchanged.

protocol.scope: Dry or total-stress homogeneous plane-strain slopes. No hydraulic coupling or post-collapse travel.
secondary_comparisons: Griffiths-Lane example2 foundation with reconstructed toe extent
solver_model_controls: DAVIS Griffiths example1: transformed strength/flow, secondary only
DAVIS phi0 homogeneous: same material flow but different solver path
DAVIS Pruska h7phi10: transformed strength/flow, secondary only

project_review_thresholds.note: These are declared project screening choices, not statutory or universal engineering tolerances. Passing a numerical comparison alone does not establish physical collapse.

protocol.failure_interpretation: Numerical failure/stagnation leaves critical FOS undetermined. A converged/nonconverged bracket is only a numerical boundary; inspect load completion, displacement trend and mechanism. Partial loading and interrupted runs are never treated as a measured critical FOS.
protocol.practical_decision: Assess whether useful safety-rate results are produced repeatably for primary cases, whether mesh/path dependence is controlled, and whether unsupported results are clearly refused. Secondary cases with missing K0/side restraints cannot alone certify or falsify the constitutive model.
protocol.material_parameters: No tuning of materials or convergence tolerances to match reference FOS.
protocol.timings: Concurrent independent Excel runs are verification timings, not a performance ranking.
